translations.web: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”
translations.bsb: “Ah, Lord GOD,” I said, “I surely do not know how to speak, for I am only a child!”
translations.kjv: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.
translations.asv: Then said I, Ah, Lord Jehovah! behold, I know not how to speak; for I am a child.
